title: Termogar
excerpt: Enterprise e-commerce platform with robust backend authentication (NextAuth), headless CMS integration (Sanity), and server-side API data fetching for scalable product management and customer analytics.

testimonial.name: Alvaro Perez Muñoz
testimonial.quote: It has been a pleasure working with Adrian; his dedication and professionalism are exemplary in the development of Termogar.

challenge: Completely overhaul an outdated WordPress website with modern technologies
solution: Architected a modern e-commerce backend using Next.js API routes with NextAuth for secure session-based authentication and role-based user management. Integrated Sanity CMS as the data warehouse for product inventory, pricing, and content management with real-time synchronization via webhooks. Implemented server-side rendering (SSR) and incremental static regeneration (ISR) for SEO optimization and performance. Built transactional email infrastructure using Resend for order confirmations and customer notifications.
